text: GAC Group's 2025 annual report names Guangzhou Automobile Industry Group (GAIG) as its controlling shareholder, holding about 54.02%, and the Guangzhou Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, a department directly under the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government, as its actual controller, holding 90% of GAIG. Nikkei Asia reports that the Guangzhou city government controls about two-thirds of GAC through several investment companies.
short: GAC Group is controlled by the Guangzhou city government: its state-assets commission is the actual controller, through GAIG's 54.02%.

source.name: Guangzhou Automobile Group Co., Ltd.: 2025 Annual Report (HKEX filing)
source.quote: GAIG is the controlling shareholder of the Company, holding approximately 54.02% of the Company’s equity interest
source.note: Chapter 8 (Changes in Shares and Information on Shareholders) names the ultimate controller as the Guangzhou State-Owned Assets Administration Bureau, a department directly under the Guangzhou Municipal People's Government, and charts its 90% of GAIG.
